stem:
Jay has to draw a shape.
- It must have 5 sides.
- It must have one line of symmetry.
Jay has started to draw the shape.
Complete Jay’s shape.

[Image: an incomplete shape with three sides forming a rectangle on a grid.]

descriptors:
Correct shape drawn which has 5 sides and 1 line of symmetry. The new vertex must be within ±2 mm of the line of symmetry (accept the new vertex anywhere on the line of symmetry, provided there are 5 sides).
[Image: figure drawn on grid with three lines forming an incomplete rectangle on the bottom. Two lines drawn on top to close the figure and form a convex interior angle.] OR
[Image: figure drawn on grid with three lines forming an incomplete rectangle on the bottom. Two lines sloping inwards are drawn on top to close the figure and form a convex interior angle.]

[Image: figure drawn on grid with three lines forming an incomplete rectangle on the bottom. The rectangle is completed with a fourth line and then two additional lines are drawn on top to close the figure and form a convex interior angle.]
Other incorrect (including crossed out, erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: A 10 by 10 square grid. A three-sided incomplete shape is drawn with thick black lines along the grid lines: a horizontal bottom segment 6 units long (leaving 2 units of margin on the left and 2 units on the right along the bottom edge of the grid), and two vertical segments each 4 units tall rising upward from the two ends of the bottom segment (leaving 6 units of grid space above them). The top of the shape is open.
